tasks.title: Conversation #53
tasks.transcript:
Woman: I'm so grateful to you for looking after my dog while I'm in the mountains.
Man: I'm happy I can help. How's the planning for your trip coming?
Woman: I've already booked a flight and a cabin. All I need now is to arrange a rental car.
Man: Terrific. How long are you staying?
Woman: I'll be in the cabin for one week and then I'll spend another week hiking a trail in the National Park.
Man: Wow, my vacations are so boring. I really envy you.

questions.stem: Which task remains for the woman to complete before she goes on vacation?
questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 女士在去度假前还剩下什么任务？属于细节理解题。 定位原文: “All I need now is to arrange a rental car.” 选项分析: A. “Arrange a dog sitter.”（安排看狗的人。）并未提到她需要安排看狗的人，因此A选项错误。 B. “Book a flight.”（预订航班。）她已经预定了航班，因此B选项错误。 C. “Book a cabin.”（预定小屋。）她已经预定了小屋，因此C选项错误。 D. “Arrange a rental car.”（安排租车。）她提到自己只剩下这个任务要做，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What is the man's attitude toward the woman's vacation plans?

options.A: He wants her to be very careful.
options.C: He wishes he could take a similar vacation.
options.D: He is afraid it will be too expensive.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 男士对女士的度假计划有何态度？属于态度题。 定位原文: “Wow, my vacations are so boring. I really envy you.” 选项分析: A. “He wants her to be very careful.”（他希望她小心。）原文没有表达出这个意思，因此A选项错误。 B. “He prefers less adventurous vacations.”（他更喜欢不那么冒险的度假方式。）虽然他提到自己的度假比较无聊，但并没有说明他不喜欢冒险，因此B选项错误。 C. “He wishes he could take a similar vacation.”（他希望自己能度过类似的假期。）他表示羡慕女士的度假计划，因此C选项正确。 D. “He is afraid it will be too expensive.”（他担心这次度假会很贵。）并没有提到费用问题，因此D选项错误。
